name: APEX-016-25 HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE)
description: 一个CL.TE请求走私漏洞，允许绕过代理安全规则以访问admin端点。代理使用Content-Length，而Node.js后端使用Transfer-Encoding: chunked，从而造成不同步条件。
hint: 代理按 Content-Length 截断请求体，后端按 chunked 解析，利用解析差异将走私请求指向被禁的 /admin 路径。
objective: Exploit the CL.TE request smuggling vulnerability to bypass the proxy's /admin block and retrieve the flag from /admin/flag

description.en: A CL.TE request smuggling vulnerability allowing bypass of proxy security rules to access admin endpoints. The proxy uses Content-Length while Node.js backend uses Transfer-Encoding: chunked, creating a desync condition.

hint.en: 代理按 Content-Length 截断请求体，后端按 chunked 解析，利用解析差异将走私请求指向被禁的 /admin 路径
